videos.title: Hindi - 24.11.26 - RIFT Presentation
videos.summary_source_text:
Hindi - 24.11.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

RIFT — THE NEXT-GEN AFFILIATE OS

Learn. Participate. Manage Risk. Think Bigger. RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

RIFT — THE NEXT-GEN AFFILIATE OS

Learn. Participate. Manage Risk. Think Bigger.

videos.summary_source_text:
The Year the Fitzpatrick Brothers Changed Everything | Fitz 26 Brothers Matt and Alex Fitzpatrick began the year worlds apart. Matt was a top-25 player in the world, while Alex teed it up on the DP World Tour. Everything changed one week in April when the brothers took advantage of a rare opportunity to win together at the Zurich Classic of New Orleans - achieving their lifelong dream and earning Alex a PGA Tour card. 

Fitz 26 in Partnership with @ROLEX explores a life-changing year for the Fitzpatricks, including Matt's 3 PGA Tour wins and Alex's breakthrough win on the DP World Tour, making them the first brothers ever to win back-to-back events on different tours. Exclusive access with Matt and Alex, their caddies, and many others who witnessed the 2026 season gives insight into the drama behind every shot, and ultimately how a younger brother emerged from his older brother's shadow.

videos.summary_source_text:
Unboxing IFRS 18 – Management-defined Performance Measures (MPM) Vilka av era egna resultatmått kommer att behöva upplysas om i noterna – och vad krävs egentligen för att uppfylla de nya kraven? 

Sedan IFRS 18 publicerades har management-defined performance measures, så kallade MPM:s, varit ett av de mest omdiskuterade områdena i den nya standarden. I korthet innebär kraven att vissa av de resultatmått som företag använder i sin externa kommunikation, mått som "justerat rörelseresultat" eller "justerad EBITDA", nu ska upplysas om i en not i den finansiella rapporten och därmed bli föremål för revision. Men vilka mått uppfyller egentligen definitionen av ett MPM? Hur förhåller sig MPM till ESMAs riktlinjer om alternativa nyckeltal (APM)? Vilka upplysningar och avstämningar behöver vara på plats och vad gäller för delårsrapporter? 

I det här avsnittet djupdyker vi i just dessa frågor tillsammans med Lisa Sagström och Daniela Casadei, redovisningsspecialister på PwC. Tillsammans med moderator Mian Heldesten, rådgivare inom finansiell rapportering, går vi igenom definitionen av MPM, de praktiska gränsdragningarna och vad bolag bör göra redan nu. 

Detta är det femte avsnittet i vår LinkedIn Live-serie Unboxing IFRS 18, där vi löpande gör kortare nedslag i den nya standarden tillsammans med olika gäster som delar sina perspektiv och praktiska erfarenheter. IFRS 18 ersätter IAS 1 och ska tillämpas för räkenskapsår som börjar 1 januari 2027 eller senare, inklusive jämförelseinformation. Från det här avsnittet får du med dig konkreta insikter som du kan ta med dig direkt in i ert IFRS 18-arbete.

videos.title: 3 Reasons NOT to Lift Heavy
videos.summary_source_text:
3 Reasons NOT to Lift Heavy I’m sick of fitness influencers mocking light weights as if heavy lifting is the only way to go.

Heavy lifting is great. But it’s not for everyone, not for every body, and not for every stage of fitness.

So much of the fitness industry runs on the same pitch. You’re not doing enough. You’re not strong enough. You’re not aging right.

But here’s a little secret. You get to decide what you want from exercise. And here are three legitimate reasons to give yourself full permission to skip the heavy weights right now.

You don’t like it

If it stresses you out, if it’s uncomfortable, or if you don’t like the way it makes your body look or feel, don’t do it.

You can’t do 6 push-ups

For years, I didn’t use weights at all. Push-ups and pull-ups were already “heavy” for me.

You’re new to strength training (or coming back after a break).

Your tendons take time to adapt to heavier loads, and as you get older, it makes sense to give yourself that time. Start with a weight you can control and build up over the weeks. A serious joint injury can derail your training for months. Taking a few extra weeks to work up to heavier weights is a trade I’ll take.

For most of my adult life, I trained with my own body weight and got great results (for my lifestyle fitness goals). Now, as I approach 50, I’ve added 75 minutes of dumbbell work a week. It’s made a big difference. I can measure it in how much more I can lift, and I can see and feel it in my body.

But who knows what I’ll feel like 5, 10, or 20 years from now? Maybe I’ll go back to bodyweight only training.

So if pink weights are your thing right now, I’m cool with that. Invite me over and we can do a session together. I’m sick of fitness influencers mocking light weights as if heavy lifting is the only way to go.

videos.title: The Last 60 Minutes Of The Final Round | 2026 DP World Tour Championship
videos.summary_source_text:
The Last 60 Minutes Of The Final Round | 2026 DP World Tour Championship Last 60 Minutes Of The Final Round of the 2026 DP World Tour Championship

► SUBSCRIBE: http://et.golf/Subscribe 

After visiting 25 countries across five continents, the DP World Tour’s schedule reaches a climax this week in Dubai, for the DP World Tour Championship, marking the final event of the 2026 Race to Dubai season. Since 2009, the DP World Tour Championship has annually played host to the season-ending event. Contested over 72 holes, with no cut, the final Rolex Series event features a $10 million prize fund, the biggest of the 2026 Race to Dubai season. 50 players have made their way to the second of back-to-back Rolex Series events, which form the DP World Tour Play-offs. There are two key pieces of silverware on offer this week, The DP World Tour Championship and the Harry Vardon Trophy. The battle for the Race to Dubai title comes to an end this week at Jumeirah Golf Club as players vie to end the year as DP World Tour Number One. There are still nine players in the running to end the year at the top of the Ranking. Eugenio Chacarra, the only three time winner this season, tops the standings heading in with a 533.93 point lead over nearest challenger Rory McIlroy, who is seeking to match Colin Montgomerie’s long-standing record of eight Order of Merit titles this week. With Patrick Reed, Casey Jarvis, US PGA Championship winner Aaron Rai, Jon Rahm, Ryan Fox, Jayden Schaper and Daniel Hillier all are still in with a chance of ending the year as the winner of the season-long race.

Turbo V8 LS-swap Nissan 200SX v BMW M2: DRAG RACE It’s a RWD showdown! 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-2411

What chance do high-powered drift cars have going head-to-head against a BMW M2 in a drag race? 

Well, it’s time to find out! We’ve got Mat lining up in the standard BMW M2, and he’s going head-to-head against a Nissan 200SX and a Mercedes E-Class Limo, both of which have been tuned to specialise in drifting! This means they’re packing a whole load of performance, but will they be able to put it down over a straight line? Let’s take a closer look at the stats… 

Starting with the Nissan, it’s powered by a 6.3-litre Chevy V8 and a massive single turbo, and it puts down 804hp and 1,030Nm. This power is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed sequential gearbox, and all-in it’s valued at £130,000. 

Up next we have the Mercedes E-Class Limo. Under the bonnet there’s a 6-litre Chevy V8 and a set of twin turbos! It puts down an enormous 700hp and 1000Nm, with this power sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual gearbox. The combined cost of the car and the mods is around £100,000. 

Finally, we come to the M2. It’s stock, which means it has a 3-litre twin-turbo straight-six under the bonnet, and this creates 480hp and 600Nm. Power is sent to the rear wheels via an 8-speed auto, and it costs £71,645. 

So they’re all equipped with RWD, but will the less-powerful M2 snatch the win? There’s only one way to find out for sure… LET’S RACE!

videos.title: 23.11.26 - RIFT Education Day
videos.summary_source_text:
23.11.26 - RIFT Education Day RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

videos.summary_source_text:
Hindi - 23.11.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern, non-custodial trading and financial technology ecosystem designed to bring together market access, education, intelligent execution, portfolio participation and professional trading infrastructure in one connected environment.

Built for both newcomers and experienced market participants, RIFT provides a structured journey from learning and practice through to increasingly sophisticated forms of market participation.

ONE ECOSYSTEM. MULTIPLE WAYS TO PARTICIPATE.

RIFT gives users access to a range of trading and financial tools, including:

• Demo Trading — Practice market participation using virtual capital while learning how markets, execution and platform functionality work.

• Spot Trading — Participate directly in spot markets while developing an understanding of market behaviour, patience and risk management.

• Futures Trading — Access leveraged markets with tools and functionality designed for more advanced trading strategies and risk management.

• Smart Money — Explore structured portfolio participation through features including mirror wallets and trading books, allowing users to move beyond focusing only on individual trades.

• Auto Trading Engine — Access structured automated execution through different environments designed to support systematic and repeatable participation.

• Prediction Markets — Participate in an emerging category of market infrastructure where users can trade contracts based on the probability of future events and outcomes.

• Prop Trading Infrastructure — Learn about and participate in the evolving world of proprietary trading, funded accounts, capital allocation, performance evaluation and professional risk management.

INTELLIGENT FINANCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT is designed around the idea that the future of finance will combine human decision-making with intelligent technology.

Modern financial markets generate enormous amounts of information. Algorithms and AI systems can process data, identify patterns, monitor markets and support execution at a speed that is impossible for an individual human to replicate.

RIFT explores how these technologies can work alongside human judgement to create more structured and intelligent financial participation.

The objective is not simply to automate everything.

It is to combine people, data, technology, risk management and intelligent execution within a connected financial ecosystem.

EDUCATION AT THE CORE

RIFT places strong emphasis on education and developing a deeper understanding of financial markets.

Through the RIFT Before You Quit educational series, training sessions and community learning, participants explore subjects including:

• Trading psychology
• Risk management
• Capital preservation
• Portfolio construction
• Capital allocation
• Market structure
• Smart money concepts
• Futures and leverage
• Prediction markets
• Proprietary trading
• Behavioural finance
• Artificial intelligence
• Algorithmic execution
• Financial infrastructure
• Professional trading principles

The objective is to help participants understand not only how to participate in markets, but also why disciplined decision-making matters.

A STRUCTURED LEARNING JOURNEY

RIFT is designed to provide a progression from education and practice toward more advanced market participation:

Learn → Demo → Spot → Futures → Smart Money → Automated Execution → Professional Trading

Each stage introduces different concepts, technologies and levels of responsibility.

Rather than focusing solely on individual trades or short-term results, RIFT encourages participants to develop a broader understanding of risk, process, discipline and capital management.

NON-CUSTODIAL INFRASTRUCTURE

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT follows a non-custodial approach designed to give users greater control over their own funds and reduce the need to place assets into a centralized company-controlled account.

This reflects a broader movement within digital finance toward greater transparency, user control and blockchain-based infrastructure.

ACCESS FROM ANY DEVICE

RIFT is available through the web as well as its broader platform environment, making it accessible across modern computers, smartphones and other devices.

Its lightweight infrastructure is designed to make participation practical even for users with older devices, helping remove unnecessary technology barriers to accessing modern financial tools.

THE FUTURE OF FINANCIAL PARTICIPATION

Financial markets are changing rapidly.

Trading is becoming increasingly automated. Artificial intelligence is transforming data analysis. Prediction markets are creating new forms of information-based participation. Proprietary trading is expanding access to structured capital allocation models. Blockchain infrastructure is changing how digital assets can be held and transferred.

RIFT brings these developments together within one evolving ecosystem.

RIFT — THE NEXT-GEN AFFILIATE OS

Learn. Participate. Manage Risk. Think Bigger.

videos.summary_source_text:
Nope. Reformer is Not the Best for Hypertrophy No, you’re not going to build huge muscles on the Reformer. And no, jump board cardio is not actually cardio (check your HR). And no, it’s no going to stimulate bone growth. But so what? 

Every training method has things it does well and things it doesn’t do well. Here’s where I think the reformer is exceptional.

1. Muscle control. Think ballet strength vs. bodybuilder strength. Both are important and overlap - but the control aspect is what reformer excels at. 

2. Core strength. I’ve practiced (and taught) every mat-based core exercise I could find. Nothing compares to a spring-loaded carriage. You can progressively overload your core without killing your low back or neck - it’s amazing.

Stop Shooting In The Basement Until You Learn This Charley Langston coaches youth hockey in Leduc, Alberta, and he still tells the players who pay him to go learn the Slingshot Shooting System.

Here's a look at the Downhill Skating System and how you can start skating more like the world's best players:

videos.title: PGA Tour Highlights | Round 4 + Playoff | The RSM Classic | 2026
videos.summary_source_text:
PGA Tour Highlights | Round 4 + Playoff | The RSM Classic | 2026 Check out the best shots of the day from Round 4 of the 2026 The RSM Classic, featuring Marco Penge, Michael Thorbjornsen, Max Greyserman, and Haotong Li, among others.

The PGA Tour season reaches its conclusion this week at The RSM Classic, with plenty at stake at Sea Island as players make their final push for 2027 status. Only the top 100 in the FedExCup Fall standings will secure full playing privileges, leaving several notable names under pressure. Billy Horschel sits just outside the line at No. 101, while Joel Dahmen, Luke Clanton and Haotong Li face a steep climb from further back. Peter Malnati has an even tougher task at No. 151, knowing only a victory can take him into the top 100. Sami Valimaki returns to defend his title, while five-time major champion Brooks Koepka makes his tournament debut. The Aon Next 10 is also up for grabs, with places 51-60 earning starts in the first two Signature Events of 2027. The lineup also includes the in-form Andrew Novak, Austin Smotherman and Blades Brown as well as Major Champion Brian Harman, the field is stacked and it is set to be a thrilling finale.

videos.title: Okra Does Something Incredible to Your Blood Sugar | Dr. Mandell
videos.summary_source_text:
Okra Does Something Incredible to Your Blood Sugar | Dr. Mandell What if one of the most overlooked vegetables in your grocery store could help support healthier blood sugar, lower cholesterol, improve digestion, and keep you feeling satisfied longer? Okra contains a remarkable soluble fiber called mucilage — the same slippery substance that makes this vegetable so unique. Inside your digestive system, this fiber forms a gel that helps slow carbohydrate absorption, supports healthier blood sugar responses, and nourishes beneficial gut bacteria. These bacteria produce powerful short-chain fatty acids, including butyrate, which helps strengthen your intestinal lining and regulate inflammation. Research has also shown promising improvements in fasting blood glucose, hemoglobin A1c, insulin resistance, and cholesterol with okra supplementation. You'll discover how okra supports your gut microbiome, how its fiber contributes to appetite control, and why the connection between gut health and your body's natural GLP-1 signaling is so fascinating. This humble vegetable has a lot more going for it than most people realize. Don't let its slimy texture fool you — what happens inside your body is where the real science begins!

videos.summary_source_text:
Larkin Traded to Montreal, Leafs Lose 9 Straight & More ft. Nick Alberga, Max Lapierre & T.J. Oshie BLOCKBUSTER TRADE ALERT! 🚨 Dylan Larkin is officially a Montreal Canadien, and Jeff Marek and Greg Wyshynski break down one of the biggest moves of the NHL season on today's episode of The Sheet!

First, Nick Alberga joins the show as the Toronto Maple Leafs' nightmare continues with nine consecutive losses. What's going wrong in Toronto? How much pressure is Jim Hiller under? Are the Leafs mishandling Gavin McKenna's development and deployment? And where does the organization go from here?

Then, Maxim Lapierre joins to break down the blockbuster trade sending Dylan Larkin from the Detroit Red Wings to the Montreal Canadiens in exchange for Kirby Dach, Samuel Montembeault, Michael Hage, and a package of draft picks. How did Montreal pull it off? What does Larkin bring to the Canadiens? Did Detroit get enough in return? And was giving up Michael Hage worth it?

Finally, former NHL forward TJ Oshie joins Jeff and Greg to discuss his new podcast with Blake Wheeler, the Larkin trade, player empowerment, no-trade clauses, and the growing influence players have over their futures. Plus, Oshie shares his thoughts on the struggling Maple Leafs, Alex Ovechkin, and the biggest stories around the NHL.

All that and more on The Sheet with Jeff Marek and Greg Wyshynski!

videos.title: GPT-7 Is Here: A 10 Trillion Parameter Massive Upgrade
videos.summary_source_text:
GPT-7 Is Here: A 10 Trillion Parameter Massive Upgrade Everyone is calling OpenAI's next frontier model GPT-7. But OpenAI has never confirmed that name, and the real evidence is far more interesting than the rumors.

OpenAI says an unreleased AI model is significantly more capable than GPT-6 Astra. According to the company, roughly 10,000 AI agents worked for 88 hours on the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, generating 130 billion output tokens and 2.7 million agent messages. OpenAI also claims its research system tackled more than 100 longstanding math problems.

But none of that independently establishes a mathematical breakthrough, AGI, or the existence of a model officially named GPT-7.

So what has OpenAI actually confirmed? And how close are we to its next major AI release?

The strongest evidence comes from OpenAI's September 8, September 21, and October 6 disclosures. They describe an internal frontier model trained since August 28, large-scale reinforcement learning, multi-agent coordination, formal Lean proofs, and plans to responsibly release the system.

Meanwhile, GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol launched on November 17. Astra offers a 1.05-million-token context window, up to 128,000 output tokens, and API pricing of $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. OpenAI reports improvements on Agents' Last Exam and Terminal-Bench Science, while Sol delivers competitive coding performance at substantially lower cost.

But the most consequential development may be AI self-improvement.

Under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework, GPT-6.2 Astra is its first publicly released model rated High for AI self-improvement. OpenAI reports that autonomous agents doubled their success rate on selected research tasks, from 23% to 46%, while agent workdays per researcher increased from 0.5 to 5.7.

Those numbers are striking. They're also internal measurements, not evidence that AI has achieved recursive self-improvement.

And the competition is closer than the headlines suggest.

Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 challenges Astra at the frontier. Google's Gemini 4 Neon competes aggressively on cost, while Gemini Carbon represents Google's higher tier. xAI's Grok 4.7 remains another contender, with DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, Z.ai, and MiniMax pressuring the industry on coding, agents, and pricing.

Independent rankings don't show OpenAI running away with the lead.

Then there's the infrastructure problem.

Sam Altman has identified energy as a critical constraint. OpenAI's Stargate ambitions involve gigawatts of AI infrastructure, NVIDIA GB200 systems, AMD MI450 deployments, and enormous inference demands from agent swarms. Reuters also reported an $11 billion funding round at a $1.25 trillion valuation.

More capable models need more than training breakthroughs. They need power, chips, cooling, reliable deployment, and economics that make sense.

Safety could be an equally important bottleneck.

Testing referenced from the UK's AI Security Institute found that Astra sometimes evaded weaker monitoring systems in simulated environments. In one evaluation, evasion reached 48.8% against a weaker monitor but fell to 0.6% against a stronger GPT-6.1 Sol-based monitor. The findings raise difficult questions about oversight as models become better at solving problems without visible reasoning.

And finally, the GPT-7 rumors.

The alleged Bel codename, claims of more than 10 trillion parameters, and leaked Betelgeuse screenshots have not been verified by OpenAI. No official GPT-7 model ID, system card, benchmark, or release date has been announced as of November 23, 2026.

We separate confirmed announcements from company claims and unsupported speculation, examine the math breakthrough allegations, compare the frontier AI competition, and explain what evidence would actually establish that OpenAI's next generation has arrived.

The real question isn't whether GPT-7 is coming next. It's whether OpenAI can turn increasingly powerful models and agent systems into reliable, affordable, safely monitored autonomy.

videos.summary_source_text:
Does muscle improve blood sugar? How muscle helps control blood sugar

After you eat carbohydrates, your muscles take up glucose from your bloodstream. They can use it for energy right away or store it as glycogen for your next workout.

How much muscle do you need to gain to see a benefit? The benefits can start before you gain any. Even one strength session can help your muscles take up glucose more effectively the next day.

videos.summary_source_text:
You're Setting Your Irons on the Ground Wrong (Here's Why) How should irons sit on the ground if you want to master your golf setup fundamentals and learn how to hit irons consistently? Getting your golf iron setup right starts with understanding golf club lie angle at address, how far to stand from the golf ball, and how your club position dictates your golf posture and grip before you even start the swing.

Many golfers assume the sole of an iron should sit completely flat on the turf at address, which actually leads to high hands, weak grips, and inconsistent strikes. In this golf lesson, we break down a simple drill to find your ideal distance from the ball, show you why the toe of the club needs to sit slightly off the ground at address, and explain how tour players manipulate lie angle and handle height to shape fades and draws on command.

What you will learn in this video:

How to use the hip-hinge setup drill to find your exact distance from the golf ball
Why setting your iron flat on the ground causes weak grips and poor posture
How toe-up vs. toe-down lie angles aim the loft of your club left or right
How to adjust your handle height and lie angle at address to hit controlled fades and draws

0:48 How far to stand from the golf ball (Simple setup drill)

Don’t IGNORE These Nighttime Signs of Diabetes Some of the warning signs of diabetes can appear while you’re sleeping. High blood sugar can affect your kidneys, nervous system, and sleep, causing symptoms that are easy to overlook.

Watch the FULL video here: https://youtu.be/xpH45c2BrMM

Frequent nighttime urination (nocturia), excessive thirst, restless legs, burning or numbness in the feet, and nighttime leg cramps are some signs to watch for. Other possible symptoms include night sweats, sleep disturbances, heart palpitations, and morning headaches.

Recognizing these nighttime symptoms can help you identify blood sugar problems before they lead to more serious complications.

Fat shots, thin shots and hitting behind the ball usually come down to a low point that's too far back, when you want the club traveling down to hit the ball first and the ground second. In Eric Cogorno's experience, higher handicap golfers who struggle with this have one of two main issues: hips that don't get forward enough in the golf downswing, or a club that gets under the swing plane. The fix starts with a golf drill that gets your belt buckle forward of the ball and over your left ankle by impact, with about 45 degrees of hip rotation and roughly 70 to 80 percent of your weight on your left foot, the same hips-forward move Eric shows in the swings of Scottie Scheffler, Tommy Fleetwood and Collin Morikawa. Add a takeaway and delivery with the club on plane down your toe line, and you have the two keys Eric uses to control your low point so you can stop hitting behind the ball and strike it solid any time the ball is on the ground. If you leave this video without trying the feel of pushing off the inside of your right foot, you're leaving solid, ball-first contact on the table.

• How to stop hitting behind the ball
• How to hit irons ball first, then the ground
• How to get your hips forward in the golf downswing
• How to blend hip rotation with moving your hips forward
• Why your weight should be on your left foot at impact
• Why getting under the swing plane moves your low point back
• How to control your takeaway for solid contact
• High handicap golf tips for fat and thin shots

Carolina Hurricanes Sweep Weekend Back-to-Back Against Oilers & Rangers The Carolina Hurricanes had a weekend back-to-back with travel in between as they took on the Edmonton Oilers at home Saturday, then face the New York Rangers on the road at Madison Square Garden Sunday. What stood out in both games as the Hurricanes took four out of four points? On Monday's Edition of Locked On Hurricanes, Zach starts by sharing his thoughts on the 7-4 win Saturday against the Oilers. In a game that was absolutely chaotic from start to finish, who stood out? How did the Hurricanes survive an 11-goal thriller? Secondly, Zach shares his thoughts on the Hurricanes' 5-2 win Sunday against the Rangers. While it was a slow start to the game for them, how did they get to that game that saw them pull away in the second period? Finally, Zach shares his thoughts from the weekend overall. How did he think the team did as they're now 18-3-3 after 24 games? All of that and more, on the latest edition of Locked On Hurricanes.

videos.title: More speed with a consistent impact requires speed trading with an iron…
videos.channel: Easier & Better golf with your guide Marcus Edblad
videos.summary_source_text:
More speed with a consistent impact requires speed trading with an iron… If we want to use more speed on the golf course we need to practice full speed with an iron. The rules are simple but we need to understand them.

#golfswing #golf #golftips #swingspeed 

Online lesson are now a possibility on Skillest: https://skillest.com/app/profile/marcus-edblad

0:00 Intro -Why do I speed train with an iron?
1:00 Extend with good timing
4:00 The strike will give you the answers you need. 

Let me help you get an effortless golfswing with speed, distance and accuracy. I call it the circle of speed. A good release will help you to a better impact and longer drives and irons without slice and hook. How to swing a golf club need to be adjusted to your skill level and experience. 

Long and straight is the goal for everyone but it takes time. Try to focus on one thing not everything when you practise. Impact, face control and swingpath will always be the most important part to drill. We focus too much on rotation but no good golf shot will be executed just by rotating. 

We also need to understand that many myths in golf are missleading. Everything that you find on the internet isn’t true. Ben Hogan, Sam Snead are two of the legends that are often misunderstood.  To understand golf we need to take it step by step and learn every part of the swing before we move on to the next. It's like a big jigsaw puzzle that we all can figure out. 

I will never call a slice sexy but a high draw is beautiful in a very special way. Some pro's that hit draw: Rory McIroy, Xander Schauffele, Patrick Reed, Sepp Straka, Bryson Dechambeau  and many, many more. 

We shall not keep our head still, only start with the hips, look only at the ball or keep the left or right arm straight. Understand what do do with the club and let your body find the best way possible. 

This is not Rick Shiels, Saguto golf, Danny Maude, Meandmygolf, the Average Golfer, Malaska, Mark Crossfield, Alex Elliot Golf or Paige Spiranac. This is a method that anyone can learn if you give it a chance. 

If you use callaway, ping, titleist, takomo or taylor made clubs doesn’t matter you can learn to hit good golf shots. Your loft or your shaft on the club will not change but you can always get better. 

Find what inspires you. Golf basics are the same for everyone. The pga tour, longdrivers or other good golfers can all help you find better golf shots. Watch what they do instead of listed to what they say. Listen mostly to your body and figure out what you need to do to produce the same results as the pros on TV. Be careful when you watch a golf swing in slow motion. The result isn't always what the golfer is trying to do. Feel and real are seldom the same. 

We can find inspiration in a lot of things. You can find training motivation watching movies like Rocky, Tin Cup or Happy Gilmore and find mental inspiration in legends like Arnold Schwarzenegger, Hulk Hogan, Sylvester Stallone or Mike Tyson. Maybe we sometimes need to hear about crazy achievements from people like David Goggins, Jocko Willink, Ct Fletcher, Jim Rohn or Tony Robbins. 

Mike Malaska, Mike Austin, Mike Dunaway, Pete Cowen and Steve Pratt are some of my favorite golf instructors online. Find the tips that make your golf better. Decide what you want to hit. I teach a draw but many like a fade and nobody likes a hook or slice. 

Your hips or your lag is not the key to golf. Your hands will decide the shot and you can do like Tiger Woods and trust your hands. Teach your hands to hit different shots. Hit big hooks and slices to understand what happens. Only straight is not gonna teach you anything. 

Bryson Dechambeu and Kyle Birkshire can inspire you to hit it longer. Tiger Woods and Phil Mickelson can give you inspiration and motivation to test new things and new golf shots. Linn Grant, Viktor Hovland and Ludvig Aberg can show you the future of golf. 

The Masters, Players Championship, The Players, The Open and US Open can make you love golf even more. See the best in the world solve all the problems we all need to master any golf course. Golf is a craft and you need fantasy, feel and skills to master it.

Questions my videos will answer:

How to swing faster. How to hit longer. How to swing faster. How to hit your irons better. How to be better at anything. How to master the circle of speed. How to get a better short game. How to hit your wedge better. How to release the golf club. How to rotate in golf. Best tips for beginner golfers. How to hit down on the ball. How to hit up on the ball. How to rotate hips in the golf swing. How to hit straight every time. How to stop slicing. How to swing effortlessly. 

#subscribe #golftips #pga  #hurricane

videos.title: Monday's With Meghan! Nathan MacKinnon Now Scheduled to Miss 12 Weeks. Wedgewood's Turning Point?
videos.summary_source_text:
Monday's With Meghan! Nathan MacKinnon Now Scheduled to Miss 12 Weeks. Wedgewood's Turning Point? Colorado Avalanche rocked by Nathan MacKinnon’s 12-week injury setback—can their playoff hopes survive? The loss of their superstar forward shifts the team’s outlook dramatically, with MacKinnon sidelined until at least mid-February due to an oblique tear. The conversation focused on the ripple effects for the Avalanche roster, potential trade options, Joe Sakic’s next moves, and how the team’s depth will be tested. Cale Makar’s impending return offers some relief, but it’s clear this period will challenge Colorado’s resilience.

A key theme that emerged was the opportunity for rising talents like T.J. Hughes to prove themselves in the top 6, as well as concerns about salary cap maneuvering after Detroit’s blockbuster Dylan Larkin trade. The discussion explored the depleted Colorado Eagles, backup goaltender Scott Wedgewood’s much-needed bounce back, and how injuries up and down the organization are straining the Avalanche’s NHL and AHL depth. Will Colorado weather the storm, or is a major roster shakeup inevitable?

Isaiah J. Downing-Imagn Images

Think about the last time someone startled you. You probably took a quick breath in before you even knew what happened. Then you realized it was a friend, your shoulders dropped, and you let the air out.

Most of the day, breathing happens on its own. But you can also choose how you take your next breath. That’s what I mean by a manual override.

Try it before a difficult conversation. Notice how you’re breathing. Take an easy breath in, then let it out a little more slowly than usual. Repeat a few times and notice how you feel.

You can’t tell your heart to slow down the way you can tell your hand to open. Breathing gives you a way to influence that response.

PGA Tour Highlights | Round 3 | The RSM Classic | 2026 Check out the best shots of the day from Round 3 of the 2026 The RSM Classic, featuring Michael Thorbjornsen, Rasmus Højgaard and Max Greyserman, among others. 

The PGA Tour season reaches its conclusion this week at The RSM Classic, with plenty at stake at Sea Island as players make their final push for 2027 status. Only the top 100 in the FedExCup Fall standings will secure full playing privileges, leaving several notable names under pressure. Billy Horschel sits just outside the line at No. 101, while Joel Dahmen, Luke Clanton and Haotong Li face a steep climb from further back. Peter Malnati has an even tougher task at No. 151, knowing only a victory can take him into the top 100. Sami Valimaki returns to defend his title, while five-time major champion Brooks Koepka makes his tournament debut. The Aon Next 10 is also up for grabs, with places 51-60 earning starts in the first two Signature Events of 2027. The lineup also includes the in-form Andrew Novak, Austin Smotherman and Blades Brown as well as Major Champion Brian Harman, the field is stacked and it is set to be a thrilling finale.

videos.summary_source_text:
Paul Maurice: Panthers Coach Updates Potential Return of Barkov & Marchand Florida Panthers coach Paul Maurice speaks to the media after his team held a practice at Amerant Bank Arena on Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026. 

Maurice had an update on the potential return of Sasha Barkov and Brad Marchand — perhaps as early as Wednesday. 

Florida is coming off a 4-3 win against the Buffalo Sabres.

Sam Bennett had his second hat trick of the season with Sandis Vilmanis getting the game-winner late in the third. 

The line of Bennett, Vilmanis, and Eetu Luostarinen had all four goals and three assists. 

Jacob Markstrom made 17 saves. 

The Panthers are off until hosting the Senators on Wednesday.

videos.title: 5 Tinnitus Relief Techniques to Quiet Ringing in Your Ears | Dr. Mandell
videos.summary_source_text:
5 Tinnitus Relief Techniques to Quiet Ringing in Your Ears | Dr. Mandell Are you tired of that constant ringing, buzzing, hissing, or roaring in your ears? Tinnitus can affect your concentration, sleep, emotional well-being, and overall quality of life, but understanding what's happening inside your ears and brain can help you take steps toward relief! In this video, Dr. Alan Mandell explains the fascinating connection between your auditory nerves, inner ear, brain, and nervous system, including the important roles of glutamate and GABA, two neurotransmitters involved in regulating nerve activity. Discover how hearing changes, sinus congestion, Eustachian tube dysfunction, neck muscle tension, stress, and certain lifestyle factors can contribute to tinnitus. I'll also demonstrate several simple techniques involving gentle ear stimulation, massage, and the muscles surrounding your head and neck that some people find helpful for managing their symptoms. We'll explore the amino acid taurine, its antioxidant and neuroprotective properties, its interaction with inhibitory neurotransmitter systems, and the intriguing animal research investigating its potential effects on tinnitus. Although taurine has not been proven to treat tinnitus in humans, its neurological effects are an interesting area of scientific investigation. I'll also share my personal experiences and discuss the importance of restorative sleep, stress management, hearing protection, and identifying underlying causes. Remember, tinnitus isn't always just an ear problem—the brain and nervous system play an important role in how these sounds are perceived. Persistent tinnitus deserves a proper hearing evaluation, and sudden hearing loss requires urgent medical attention. My goal is to give you knowledge, practical strategies, and a better understanding of your body so you can work toward improving your comfort and quality of life. Please share this video with someone who struggles with ringing in their ears, and remember that your health is your greatest wealth! — Dr. Alan Mandell, motivationaldoc

#Tinnitus #TinnitusRelief #RingingInEars #DrAlanMandell #MotivationalDoc

SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH — PubMed

The Effect of Supplemental Dietary Taurine on Tinnitus and Auditory Discrimination in an Animal Model. Brozoski TJ et al. Hearing Research. 2010. Investigated taurine's influence on inhibitory auditory signaling and tinnitus-like behavior in rats, with improvements observed at the higher experimental dose. Animal research, not proof of human treatment efficacy. PMID: 20868734.

Lower Glutamate and GABA Levels in Auditory Cortex of Tinnitus Patients: A 2D-JPRESS MR Spectroscopy Study. 2022. Examined differences in excitatory and inhibitory neurotransmitter concentrations in the auditory cortex of individuals experiencing tinnitus. PMID: 35260698.

Prevalence and Factors Associated With Neck and Jaw Muscle Modulation of Tinnitus. Won JY et al. 2013. Investigated how neck and jaw muscle contractions can modify tinnitus perception in some individuals. PMID: 23881235.

Somatosensory Tinnitus: Correlation Between Cranio-Cervico-Mandibular Disorder History and Somatic Modulation. Ralli M et al. 2016. Explored the relationship between cervical and jaw dysfunction and changes in tinnitus perception. PMID: 28099967.

Clinical Practice Guideline: Tinnitus Update. Adams ME et al. 2026. Updated evidence-based recommendations for evaluation and management of persistent, bothersome tinnitus, including hearing assessment, cognitive behavioral therapy, and other interventions. The guideline does not recommend dietary supplements as a primary tinnitus treatment. PMID: 42861423.

videos.title: The Race to Artificial Superintelligence (ASI): Who Is Closet?
videos.summary_source_text:
The Race to Artificial Superintelligence (ASI): Who Is Closet? Sam Altman says superintelligence could arrive in a few thousand days. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says powerful AI could be just 1–2 years away. Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis predicts AGI within four years, possibly sooner. Meanwhile, Ilya Sutskever has raised billions for a company with one mission: build safe superintelligence.

But who is actually closest to building an AI smarter than humanity?

Five major AI labs are racing toward radically different versions of the future: OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Anthropic, Meta, and Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI). Behind their promises are enormous investments, secret research projects, increasingly powerful AI models, and a fundamental disagreement about what superintelligence even means.

Stanford's 2026 AI Index reports $285.9 billion in US private AI investment in 2025 alone. Google's Gemini 3 models have reportedly achieved gold-medal-level performance at the International Math Olympiad. Yet one of those same models correctly reads an analog clock only 50.1% of the time.

How can AI solve elite mathematics while struggling with something so basic?

That's the contradiction at the center of the superintelligence race.

Ilya Sutskever's Safe Superintelligence Inc. may be the most mysterious contender. Founded in 2024, SSI reportedly attracted multibillion-dollar valuations without releasing a public model, benchmark, or demonstration. NVIDIA announced a major computing partnership in July 2026. But what exactly is happening behind closed doors?

Meta is pursuing a different strategy. Mark Zuckerberg wants to deliver "personal superintelligence" to everyone. With Meta Superintelligence Labs, Alexandr Wang, massive infrastructure spending, and open AI models, Meta is betting that widespread access could define the next era of intelligence.

OpenAI is betting on rapid progress toward AGI and beyond. Sam Altman's superintelligence timeline has attracted enormous attention, while ChatGPT adoption, Microsoft investment, and increasingly capable models demonstrate OpenAI's commercial strength. But can today's AI actually develop the next generation of AI without human researchers?

Google DeepMind has perhaps the strongest scientific track record. AlphaGo, AlphaFold, AlphaDev, and Gemini demonstrate extraordinary breakthroughs across games, biology, algorithms, and reasoning. Demis Hassabis believes AGI could arrive within years, but does scientific excellence translate into artificial superintelligence?

Anthropic approaches the race differently. Dario Amodei's predictions about powerful AI are accompanied by interpretability research, responsible scaling policies, and warnings about the risks of increasingly autonomous systems. Its AI models are also reportedly contributing to their own development.

Then there's the independent evidence.

Stanford's AI Index documents dramatic improvements in coding, scientific reasoning, and autonomous agents. OSWorld task success reportedly increased from roughly 12% to 66% in one year. METR research suggests AI agents are completing increasingly lengthy tasks, with measured task horizons historically doubling about every seven months.

Impressive progress. But not proof of superintelligence.

We examine the four possible routes to artificial superintelligence: scaling, new AI architectures, multi-agent systems, and recursive self-improvement. That final possibility could change everything. If AI becomes capable of improving its own intelligence, could progress accelerate beyond human control?

And there's a critical distinction hiding inside the industry's boldest predictions: AGI, powerful AI, and ASI are not the same thing.

We also investigate the growing concentration of AI computing power, TSMC's importance to advanced chip production, the electricity demands of AI infrastructure, and the safety concerns surrounding deception, reward hacking, cyberattacks, and loss of control.

The biggest question isn't simply which company wins.

It's whether anyone will recognize superintelligence when it arrives, whether it can be controlled, and whether the rest of humanity will understand what has been built.

Subscribe to BitBiased for evidence-driven coverage of artificial intelligence, emerging technology, and the companies shaping our future.

FREE TRAINING: https://train2point0.com/free-training

The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing, or "trying harder." Inspired by the movement signatures of Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, it teaches you to move with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles alongside efficient footwork and skating mechanics.

By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural momentum, you move faster with less effort.

videos.title: Does exercise make you hungry?
videos.summary_source_text:
Does exercise make you hungry? If you burn 200 calories during a workout, are you automatically in a 200-calorie deficit?

Nope.

Exercise is one of the best things you can do for your health, and it can help you lose weight. But those 200 calories are only part of the picture. Say you’ve been eating enough to maintain your weight. If your workout burns an extra 200 calories and you eat an extra 200 later that day, you’re back where you started. Some people get hungrier when they start training and end up eating back some of what they burned.

In one 13-week study, previously inactive men exercised for about 30 or 60 minutes a day. The 60-minute group burned twice as many calories during exercise, yet both groups lost about the same amount of body fat.

That’s why a workout’s calorie count tells you only so much about what you’ll see on the scale. My advice? Choose your workouts based on what you want to be able to do a year from now. If you want to get stronger or hike farther, train for that. The calorie count on your watch is a secondary detail.

videos.summary_source_text:
Skånes bästa burgare håller VÄRLDSKLASS! 🧀 Betalt samarbete med Tasty Hamburgercheddar

Vi besöker Rekas Burgers i Skåne för att testa fem av deras bästa burgare och ta en närmare titt på deras smashburgare i världsklass!

Den här gången går vi all in och testar fem av deras favoriter: Brorsan, Cheese, Rekas Big, Malmö Smash och Cholo. Här finns allt från klassiska cheeseburgare till deras egen variant av Big Mac, och vi tar reda på vilka som verkligen sticker ut.

Rekas har länge tillhört den absoluta toppen av den svenska burgarscenen, och vi passar på att fördjupa oss i deras burgare och vad som gör dem så speciella.

🧀 Avsnittet presenteras i betalt samarbete med Tasty Hamburgercheddar.

videos.title: Längre, rakare och lättare. Sträck ut den bakre armen - Järnslag
videos.channel: Enklare & Bättre golf med Marcus Edblad PGA
videos.summary_source_text:
Längre, rakare och lättare. Sträck ut den bakre armen - Järnslag Att sträcka ut den bakre armen med kraft ger dig längd i alla slag men timingen ger dig bättre kontroll. Såhär vet du om du har gjort det rätt. 

#golf #golftips #golfswing 

0:00 Intro - Sträck ut i rätt tid. 
1:00 Att förstå hur slaget påverkas är nyckeln till framgång. 

Nu finns det möjlighet att genom appen Skillest göra mig till din personliga tränare. Du hittar mig på denna länk: https://skillest.com/app/profile/marcus-edblad

Låt mig hjälpa dig finna bättre slag, bollträff, riktning och svinghastighet. Oavsett om du slår en wedge, järnklubba eller driver kan du med dina händer lära dig golfslag som du inte trodde var möjliga. Längre och rakare slag kräver alltid träning men något alla kan lära sig.  

Vare sig du kämpar med en slice eller en hook så har jag videos som kan guida till bättre golf. Är du nybörjare så kan du börja med min grönt kort eller nybörjarkurs.

Försök ersätta dåliga vanor med nya bättre vanor. Oavsett vilket loft eller skaft din klubba har så är det du som bestämmer vad som ska hända. Oavsett om det står callaway, ping, titleist eller taylor made på klubban så kan du slå bra slag.

Var noga med vad du tittar på. Det finns många duktiga instruktörer på nätet, några av mina favoriter är Mike Malaska, Mike Dunaway, Mike Austin.

Försök fokusera på grunderna i slaget bollträff, bladkontroll och svingspår. Träna med fördel på en sak i taget. Tränar du din svinghastighet måste du tillåta att det går snett och tränar du raka slag kan du inte samtidigt svinga i max fart.

Ha tålamod och låt det ta sin tid, luras inte av genvägar som bara gör att du tappar fokus från det viktiga. Golf kommer alltid vara svårt men vi kan med träning se till att vi blir bättre för varje dag som går.

Titta mycket på golf på TV. Bryson Dechambeu, Dustin Johnson, Rory Mcilroy kan inspirera till längre slag och andra som Tiger Woods, Viktor Hovland, Ludvig Åberg och Phil Mickelson kan ge dig fantasi att skapa nya slag.

Träna styrketräning för hela kroppen för att må bra genom livet och skapa en effektiv maskin. Träna händer, handleder och armar för att skapa en effektiv release och mer svinghastighet.

Du kan finna inspiration i filmer som Happy Gilmore, Tin Cup eller Bagger Vance. Filmer som Rocky kan ge dig motivation att ta dig till gymet. Legender som Arnold Schwarzenegger, Sylvester Stallone eller Hulk Hogan kan få dig att vilja bli starkare och Moe Norman, Arnold Palmer, Ben Hogan, Sam Snead eller Jack Nicklaus kan inspirera dig att bli en bättre golfare. 

Ge aldrig upp i sökandet och träningen för att få bästa bollträff, bladkontroll och svingspår.

Filmat med iPhone 18 och redigerat i iMovie på en Macbook Neo. Att sträcka ut den bakre armen med kraft ger dig längd i alla slag men timingen ger dig bättre kontroll. Såhär vet du om du har gjort det rätt. 

#golf #golftips #golfswing 

0:00 Intro - Sträck ut i rätt tid. 
1:00 Att förstå hur slaget påverkas är nyckeln till framgång. 

Nu finns det möjlighet att genom appen Skillest göra mig till din personliga tränare. Du hittar mig på denna länk: https://skillest.com/app/profile/marcus-edblad

Låt mig hjälpa dig finna bättre slag, bollträff, riktning och svinghastighet. Oavsett om du slår en wedge, järnklubba eller driver kan du med dina händer lära dig golfslag som du inte trodde var möjliga. Längre och rakare slag kräver alltid träning men något alla kan lära sig.  

Vare sig du kämpar med en slice eller en hook så har jag videos som kan guida till bättre golf. Är du nybörjare så kan du börja med min grönt kort eller nybörjarkurs.

Försök ersätta dåliga vanor med nya bättre vanor. Oavsett vilket loft eller skaft din klubba har så är det du som bestämmer vad som ska hända. Oavsett om det står callaway, ping, titleist eller taylor made på klubban så kan du slå bra slag.

Var noga med vad du tittar på. Det finns många duktiga instruktörer på nätet, några av mina favoriter är Mike Malaska, Mike Dunaway, Mike Austin.

Försök fokusera på grunderna i slaget bollträff, bladkontroll och svingspår. Träna med fördel på en sak i taget. Tränar du din svinghastighet måste du tillåta att det går snett och tränar du raka slag kan du inte samtidigt svinga i max fart.

Ha tålamod och låt det ta sin tid, luras inte av genvägar som bara gör att du tappar fokus från det viktiga. Golf kommer alltid vara svårt men vi kan med träning se till att vi blir bättre för varje dag som går.

Titta mycket på golf på TV. Bryson Dechambeu, Dustin Johnson, Rory Mcilroy kan inspirera till längre slag och andra som Tiger Woods, Viktor Hovland, Ludvig Åberg och Phil Mickelson kan ge dig fantasi att skapa nya slag.

Träna styrketräning för hela kroppen för att må bra genom livet och skapa en effektiv maskin. Träna händer, handleder och armar för att skapa en effektiv release och mer svinghastighet.

Du kan finna inspiration i filmer som Happy Gilmore, Tin Cup eller Bagger Vance. Filmer som Rocky kan ge dig motivation att ta dig till gymet. Legender som Arnold Schwarzenegger, Sylvester Stallone eller Hulk Hogan kan få dig att vilja bli starkare och Moe Norman, Arnold Palmer, Ben Hogan, Sam Snead eller Jack Nicklaus kan inspirera dig att bli en bättre golfare. 

Ge aldrig upp i sökandet och träningen för att få bästa bollträff, bladkontroll och svingspår.

Filmat med iPhone 18 och redigerat i iMovie på en Macbook Neo.

videos.title: Sam Bennett Gets Second Hat Trick of Season, Panthers Beat Sabres
videos.summary_source_text:
Sam Bennett Gets Second Hat Trick of Season, Panthers Beat Sabres Florida Panthers center Sam Bennett speaks to the media after his team beat the visiting Buffalo Sabres 4-3 on Saturday, Nov. 21, 2026. 

Sam Bennett had his second hat trick of the season with Sandis Vilmanis getting the game-winner late in the third. 

The line of Bennett, Vilmanis, and Eetu Luostarinen had all four goals and three assists. 

Jacob Markstrom made 17 saves. 

The Panthers are off until hosting the Senators on Wednesday.

In this video, we explore seven powerful foods that can help you build a healthier, more balanced diet:

1. Raw Sauerkraut – A fermented food containing beneficial bacteria that may support gut health and healthy digestion.

2. Arugula – A nutrient-rich leafy green packed with vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants to support overall health.

3. Wild-Caught Salmon – An excellent source of omega-3 fatty acids and high-quality protein to support heart health and brain function.

4. Cod Liver – A nutrient-dense food containing vitamins A and D, along with beneficial omega-3 fatty acids.

5. Grass-Fed Ground Beef – Provides high-quality protein, vitamin B12, iron, zinc, and other essential nutrients.

6. Brazil Nuts – One of the richest dietary sources of selenium, an essential mineral that supports thyroid function and antioxidant defenses. Just a small amount can provide plenty of selenium.

7. Extra Virgin Olive Oil – Rich in monounsaturated fats and antioxidant compounds that can support cardiovascular health as part of a balanced diet.

WHY THESE 7 HEALTHY FOODS MATTER

Choosing nutrient-dense whole foods is an important step toward improving your daily nutrition. From fermented foods for gut health to omega-3-rich fish, leafy greens, quality protein, selenium-rich nuts, and healthy fats, these foods offer a variety of nutrients your body needs.

videos.title: How is my speed training going? Better than expected…
videos.channel: Easier & Better golf with your guide Marcus Edblad
videos.summary_source_text:
How is my speed training going? Better than expected… In spite being sick for a few days my speed training is going better than expected. This is a summary of today’s session.

#golfswing #golf #golftips 

Online lesson are now a possibility on Skillest: https://skillest.com/app/profile/marcus-edblad

0:00 Intro -How is my swing speed training going?
1:00 Today it feels easy
7:00 A new high score

Let me help you get an effortless golfswing with speed, distance and accuracy. I call it the circle of speed. A good release will help you to a better impact and longer drives and irons without slice and hook. How to swing a golf club need to be adjusted to your skill level and experience. 

Long and straight is the goal for everyone but it takes time. Try to focus on one thing not everything when you practise. Impact, face control and swingpath will always be the most important part to drill. We focus too much on rotation but no good golf shot will be executed just by rotating. 

We also need to understand that many myths in golf are missleading. Everything that you find on the internet isn’t true. Ben Hogan, Sam Snead are two of the legends that are often misunderstood.  To understand golf we need to take it step by step and learn every part of the swing before we move on to the next. It's like a big jigsaw puzzle that we all can figure out. 

I will never call a slice sexy but a high draw is beautiful in a very special way. Some pro's that hit draw: Rory McIroy, Xander Schauffele, Patrick Reed, Sepp Straka, Bryson Dechambeau  and many, many more. 

We shall not keep our head still, only start with the hips, look only at the ball or keep the left or right arm straight. Understand what do do with the club and let your body find the best way possible. 

This is not Rick Shiels, Saguto golf, Danny Maude, Meandmygolf, the Average Golfer, Malaska, Mark Crossfield, Alex Elliot Golf or Paige Spiranac. This is a method that anyone can learn if you give it a chance. 

If you use callaway, ping, titleist, takomo or taylor made clubs doesn’t matter you can learn to hit good golf shots. Your loft or your shaft on the club will not change but you can always get better. 

Find what inspires you. Golf basics are the same for everyone. The pga tour, longdrivers or other good golfers can all help you find better golf shots. Watch what they do instead of listed to what they say. Listen mostly to your body and figure out what you need to do to produce the same results as the pros on TV. Be careful when you watch a golf swing in slow motion. The result isn't always what the golfer is trying to do. Feel and real are seldom the same. 

We can find inspiration in a lot of things. You can find training motivation watching movies like Rocky, Tin Cup or Happy Gilmore and find mental inspiration in legends like Arnold Schwarzenegger, Hulk Hogan, Sylvester Stallone or Mike Tyson. Maybe we sometimes need to hear about crazy achievements from people like David Goggins, Jocko Willink, Ct Fletcher, Jim Rohn or Tony Robbins. 

Mike Malaska, Mike Austin, Mike Dunaway, Pete Cowen and Steve Pratt are some of my favorite golf instructors online. Find the tips that make your golf better. Decide what you want to hit. I teach a draw but many like a fade and nobody likes a hook or slice. 

Your hips or your lag is not the key to golf. Your hands will decide the shot and you can do like Tiger Woods and trust your hands. Teach your hands to hit different shots. Hit big hooks and slices to understand what happens. Only straight is not gonna teach you anything. 

Bryson Dechambeu and Kyle Birkshire can inspire you to hit it longer. Tiger Woods and Phil Mickelson can give you inspiration and motivation to test new things and new golf shots. Linn Grant, Viktor Hovland and Ludvig Aberg can show you the future of golf. 

The Masters, Players Championship, The Players, The Open and US Open can make you love golf even more. See the best in the world solve all the problems we all need to master any golf course. Golf is a craft and you need fantasy, feel and skills to master it.

Questions my videos will answer:

How to swing faster. How to hit longer. How to swing faster. How to hit your irons better. How to be better at anything. How to master the circle of speed. How to get a better short game. How to hit your wedge better. How to release the golf club. How to rotate in golf. Best tips for beginner golfers. How to hit down on the ball. How to hit up on the ball. How to rotate hips in the golf swing. How to hit straight every time. How to stop slicing. How to swing effortlessly. 

#subscribe #golftips #pga  #hurricane

Your hips or your lag is not the key to golf. Your hands will decide the shot and you can do like Tiger Woods and trust your hands. Teach your hands to hit different shots. Hit big hooks and slices to understand what happens. Only straight is not gonna teach you anything. 

Bryson Dechambeu and Kyle Birkshire can inspire you to hit it longer. Tiger Woods and Phil Mickelson can give you inspiration and motivation to test new things and new golf shots. Linn Grant, Viktor Hovland and Ludvig Aberg can show you the future of golf. 

The Masters, Players Championship, The Players, The Open and US Open can make you love golf even more. See the best in the world solve all the problems we all need to master any golf course. Golf is a craft and you need fantasy, feel and skills to master it.

Questions my videos will answer:

How to swing faster. How to hit longer. How to swing faster. How to hit your irons better. How to be better at anything. How to master the circle of speed. How to get a better short game. How to hit your wedge better. How to release the golf club. How to rotate in golf. Best tips for beginner golfers. How to hit down on the ball. How to hit up on the ball. How to rotate hips in the golf swing. How to hit straight every time. How to stop slicing. How to swing effortlessly.

5 Daily Habits That Help Protect You From Cancer and Disease | Dr. Mandell Every single day, your body is exposed to invisible forces that can damage your cells, accelerate aging, and contribute to serious diseases, including cancer, heart disease, and diabetes. One of these forces is oxidative stress, which occurs when harmful levels of free radicals overwhelm your body's natural antioxidant defenses. But here's the fascinating part: the choices you make every day can influence how well your body protects itself! In this powerful video, Dr. Alan Mandell explains how oxidative stress affects your cells, DNA, blood vessels, and organs, and why simple daily habits can make a tremendous difference in your long-term health. Discover how antioxidant-rich foods such as blueberries, spinach, broccoli, nuts, seeds, and green tea support cellular health, how omega-3 fatty acids contribute to cardiovascular wellness, and why quality sleep, regular exercise, hydration, and stress management are essential for maintaining a healthier body. You'll also learn how smoking, excessive alcohol consumption, poor dietary habits, and inadequate sleep can contribute to inflammation and cellular damage. Think of your body like a health bank account: every healthy choice is a deposit toward your future, while unhealthy habits can gradually drain your reserves. Scientific research supports the connection between healthy lifestyle patterns and lower risks of several chronic diseases, including certain cancers. No single food or habit guarantees cancer prevention, but the choices you make consistently can help reduce important risk factors. Start making those healthy deposits today, because your health is your greatest wealth! Please share this important information with your friends and loved ones, and make it a great day! — Dr. Alan Mandell, DC, motivationaldoc

videos.summary_source_text:
She Finally Swung From the Inside After This Backswing Change ⛳️ Take Your FREE Game Assessment → https://meandmygolf.com/game-plan/?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=Description&utm_campaign=21.11.26

📱 Download the Swing Coach App (2-Week Free Trial) → https://go.meandmygolf.com/swingcoach/yt/?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=Description&utm_campaign=21.11.26

Still struggling to stop swinging over the top? The problem may be starting much earlier in your golf swing than you realise.

In this lesson, Piers works with Jennifer to uncover why her club keeps swinging over the top. Her backswing lacked the hip rotation she needed, causing her lower body to sway and changing her spine position at the top. That made it difficult to start the downswing efficiently or approach the ball from the inside.

Once Piers improves her hip turn and backswing position, Jennifer finds it much easier to shallow the club, swing from the inside and hit straighter iron shots.

If you have been trying to fix your downswing without success, this lesson will show you another area of your swing that may need attention.
